result.topic_en: Gauss's German notes on a torsion-balance or oscillation experiment: a correction of observed times for finite (not infinitely small) oscillation amplitude, followed by tables of timed passages and scale readings for a load with the weights at distance 177.45.

methods.what: Correction of each observed time instant for the finite (not infinitely small) amplitude of oscillation, proportional to the square of the arc times the period
Rescaling of the denominator of the amplitude correction when a different logarithmic decrement h is used in place of 0.00126
methods.quote:
Der Nenner wird $21887500 \frac{\delta h}{0{,}00126}$ wenn statt des
logarithmischen Decrements 0,00126 ein anderes = h angenommen
wird.

methods.what: Reduction of the timed passages to mean epochs, giving the oscillation period at intermediate oscillation numbers
